description: This file defines the AccessControlList class and related nested classes and functions for managing access control policies, including roles, plugins, rules, and URL filtering, in a C++ project. It includes JSON serialization/deserialization, regex-based URL matching, and permission checks.

classes.name: AccessControlList
classes.description: Main class managing access control policies, including URL filtering, roles, and plugin rules, with methods for loading configuration and checking permissions.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL
classes.description: Nested class representing the JSON structure for ACL configuration, including groups and roles.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Plugins
classes.description: Nested class managing plugin rules and default behaviors within the ACL.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Plugins::Rules
classes.description: Defines rules for a plugin, including default access mode and allowed methods.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Roles
classes.description: Manages roles and associated plugins within the ACL.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Group
classes.description: Represents a URL group with associated role for access control.

classes.name: AccessControlList::Filter
classes.description: Handles filtering logic for URL and call sign based permissions, including regex matching for methods and callsigns.

classes.name: AccessControlList::Filter::Plugin
classes.description: Represents a plugin's permission rules, including allowed methods and default blocking behavior.

methods.name: CreateRegex
methods.description: Creates a regex pattern from a string, replacing wildcards and special characters.

methods.name: CreateUrlRegex
methods.description: Creates a regex pattern for URLs, handling special characters and wildcards.

methods.name: GetUrlOrigin
methods.description: Extracts the origin part of a URL according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads ACL configuration from a file, parsing JSON and setting up URL filters and roles.

methods.name: Filter::Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a method is allowed for a given plugin based on regex rules.

methods.name: Filter::Allowed (overload)
methods.description: Checks if a call sign and method are permitted based on plugin rules.
